text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research focused on predicting future land use change (LUC) hot-spots across the entirety of Italy—a national-scale spatial implementation. It uses an ensemble of 32 simulations based on two climate scenarios (A2/B2), two demographic trends, and toggling of model options (protected areas, spatial adjacency, past trends), satisfying the requirement of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The modeling is spatially explicit using a modified CLUE-S model (LUC@CMCC) at 500-m resolution, includes mapped LULC projections for 2100, and reports quantitative metrics such as area change percentages, stability factors, ROC/AUC accuracy (average 0.86), and hotspot agreement levels across administrative, biogeographical, physiographic, and catchment scales. The primary objective is LULC prediction, not merely using it as input. All core inclusion criteria are met; none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
